title_en: Funny Stories from Life (4/20): Neither Dared to Admit They Didn't Like Hot Pot
note_en: 反而 means "on the contrary" or "instead," signaling a result opposite to what you'd expect: 约会反而变得轻松多了 "the dates actually got much more relaxed" (you'd expect the confession to make things awkward). English often just stresses "actually" or "if anything"; Chinese marks the surprise with 反而 placed right before the verb.
